## Kyoto Spring Trip Overview

A 4-day Kyoto plan for **2 adults** with a **$1,800 budget excluding flights** can fit comfortably in a **3-star or better** stay, especially if you choose a transit-friendly base and mix free temple visits with a few paid sights.
Best fit for your style: **Higashiyama/Gion** for atmosphere, or **Kyoto Station** for convenience.

## Recommended Stay Areas and 4-Day Kyoto Plan

| Day | Focus | Best Area to Stay | Main Highlights | Budget Lean |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mar 12 | East Kyoto arrival + temples | Higashiyama / Gion | Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Yasaka Shrine | Moderate |
| Mar 13 | Arashiyama + river scenery | Kyoto Station / Central Kyoto | Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, Togetsukyo Bridge | Moderate |
| Mar 14 | Quiet neighborhoods + local food | Gion / Kawaramachi | Philosopher’s Path, Nanzen-ji, Nishiki Market | Moderate |
| Mar 15 | Northern temples + departure day | Kyoto Station / Central Kyoto | Kinkaku-ji, Nijo Castle, easy transit wrap-up | Light |

### Day 1: East Kyoto arrival and temple streets
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and settle near **Higashiyama** or **Gion** for walkable streets and easy bus access.
- Afternoon: Visit **Kiyomizu-dera**, then stroll **Sannenzaka** and **Ninenzaka** for classic Kyoto lanes.
- Evening: Have a quiet dinner around **Gion** or **Kawaramachi**; try tofu, yudofu, or a seasonal kaiseki set.

### Day 2: Arashiyama and western Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Go early to **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** before crowds build.
- Afternoon: Visit **Tenryu-ji** and walk to **Togetsukyo Bridge**; add the river path if you want a slower pace.
- Evening: Return to central Kyoto for an easy dinner near the station or Pontocho.

### Day 3: Quiet Kyoto neighborhoods and local food
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Walk the **Philosopher’s Path** and visit **Nanzen-ji** for a calmer temple experience.
- Afternoon: Explore small shops and lunch at **Nishiki Market** or nearby side streets.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Explore small shops and lunch at **Nishiki Market** or nearby side streets, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Keep it low-key with a neighborhood izakaya or soba shop in **Gion** or **Karasuma**.

### Day 4: Northern highlights and flexible departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kinkaku-ji** early for the best light and lighter crowds.
- Afternoon: Stop at **Nijo Castle** if time allows, or use the remaining time for shopping and café breaks.
- Evening: Head to the airport or next destination from a transit-friendly base near **Kyoto Station**.

## Budget Breakdown for 2 Adults

| Category | Estimated Total | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Lodging | **$720–$1,000** | 3-star hotel, 4 nights, roughly $180–$250 per night |
| Food | **$300–$480** | Mix of casual meals, market lunches, and 1 nicer dinner |
| Transit | **$40–$90** | Subway, buses, occasional taxi, and local rail |
| Attractions | **$80–$180** | Temple/castle entry fees and optional extras |
| Buffer / snacks / misc. | **$100–$180** | Coffee, convenience items, small purchases |
| Total | **$1,240–$1,930** | Comfortable target range for your $1,800 cap |

### Best Area Choice by Priority
- **Best overall:** **Higashiyama / Gion** — most atmospheric, great for temples and walking.
- **Best transit convenience:** **Kyoto Station** — easiest for trains, airport access, and day-trip flexibility.
- **Best food-and-evening balance:** **Kawaramachi / Karasuma** — central, lively, and still practical.

### Lodging Target
- Aim for a **3-star hotel or boutique business hotel** with:
  - station or subway access within 5–10 minutes
  - breakfast included or nearby cafés
  - quiet room options if possible
- Good nightly target for your budget: **$180–$230 before taxes/fees** if you want the trip to stay comfortably under budget.
